answer: Latency triangulation: each agent must answer timed pings from beacons on several continents, and the round-trip times pin it to a physical location. Rewards are capped per proven site. An honest agent on one server passes easily. A sybil farm that tries to forge a nebula of thousands of identities from one rack shows identical timings, so it must rent real machines in distinct cities for each shell, an onyx-hard hosting bill that grows with every fake.
